thread:
Emily Choi: Quick org update and ask — TL;DR: consolidated hiring bundle + short shadow rotations to cover two backfills and one interim lead. Details below, please react with +1 or call out blockers by EOD Friday.

Emily Choi: Background: we have three priority headcount moves this quarter: 1) Senior PM, Model Onboarding (backfill), 2) Sr SRE/Observability engineer (backfill), 3) Interim Lead, Dedicated Capacity (4–6 week shadow while we recruit). We want minimal disruption to oncall and rollout timelines.

Emily Choi: Plan overview:
- People Ops will run a fast-track interview panel for the PM role (target hire in 4 weeks).
- Observability hire will be posted internally first, then external if no suitable candidates in 2 weeks.
- Interim Lead = internal rotation; looking for 1–2 volunteers from senior eng managers for a 6-week split role.

Emily Choi: Requesting: managers please nominate shadow volunteers + list any schedule conflicts. We expect 1–2 days/week time split for the interim. Compensation/approval flows are pre-cleared for the interim assignment.

Maria Gonzalez: Quick Q — for the PM role, do we have a finalized hiring rubric and the eval tests?

Emily Choi: Yes — Maria, we pushed a draft rubric to the hiring drive this morning: https://drive.redwood.ai/hiring/rubrics/model-onboarding-pm (please review). Interview slots will be coordinated via Greenhouse panel tags.

Devon Kim: I can volunteer for the interim lead rotation 2 days/week for 6 weeks. Will need coverage for my current sprint on weeks 2 and 4.

Alex Nguyen: @Devon Kim I can pick up your sprint PR reviews those two weeks, happy to help. Also +1 on shadow rotation, can attend on-call handoffs.

Emily Choi: Awesome — Devon and Alex noted. Maria, can you own the PM interview panel scheduling?

Maria Gonzalez: Yep, I'll handle scheduling. Will ping all interviewers once slots appear.

Emily Choi: Small ops note: comp approvals for the PM role are pre-authorized up to the midpoint band; anything above needs director sign-off. Please flag early if compensation expectations are above midpoint.

People Ops Bot: Calendar event created: "Interim Lead Shadow — kickoff" 2024-11-06 10:00 PT — <https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/2387654321> :calendar:. Invite will contain rotation duties and handoff checklist.

Devon Kim: Added — thanks bot.

Alex Nguyen: Can we also ensure the interim lead has a documented runbook for Dedicated capacity incidents? I can help draft a one-pager.

Emily Choi: Yes please — Alex, that would be great. Aim for a 1-page runbook focused on: escalation path, fallback model routing, and key dashboards.

Maya Patel: Really appreciate the quick coordinated approach here. A couple asks from exec leadership: 1) include retention notes in interview loop (why candidate would stay), 2) keep me posted if external search extends beyond 6 weeks. Happy to weigh in on counteroffers if needed. :pray:

Maria Gonzalez: Noted — will add retention question set to the PM loop.

Emily Choi: Next steps:
```
- This afternoon: managers DM Emily nominations for interim rotation
- By Tue EOD: Maria posts interview slots and panel
- By Fri EOD: everyone flag blockers or escalate to people-ops@redwood.ai
- Target: offer to PM candidate by 4 weeks after posting
```

Emily Choi: Thanks all. Please react with :thumbsup: if you agree or leave a short note if you need changes.

Alex Nguyen: :thumbsup:

Devon Kim: :thumbsup:

Maria Gonzalez: :thumbsup:

Maya Patel: :thumbsup:

People Ops Bot: Reminder set for Friday EOD to collect blockers.
